hel:dice.name: Dice
hel:dice.effect_text: Give yourself 2 stacks of luck; cause 6[[icon:D]]to the target; if this damage is a critical hit, the final damage will be +3[[icon:D]]
hel:dice.description: Roll a six and win big!

hel:clover.name: Clover
hel:clover.effect_text: When the equipment exists, the target's critical strike multiplier +0.5×; at the start of the target's turn, apply 3 stacks of luck to it.

hel:poker_card.name: Poker Card
hel:poker_card.effect_text:
Gain 4 stacks of luck to yourself; cause 8[[icon:D]]to the target; if this damage is a critical hit, a random color effect will be triggered. If your luck exceeds 12 layers, choose instead:
♥ Self[[icon:H]]Recover 7[[icon:H]]when it is less than 50% of the maximum
♦ The final damage this time is +6[[icon:D]]♠ Draw 1 card
♣Apply 3[[icon:P]]to the target

hel:poker_chip.name: Poker Chip
hel:poker_chip.effect_text: Gain 3 Luck; deal 6[[icon:D]] to the target. This damage cannot critically hit.
hel:poker_chip.description: Why not do it if you are sure to make a profit without losing money?

hel:domino.name: Domino
hel:domino.effect_text: Gain 2 stacks of luck for yourself; cause 6[[icon:D]]to the target; if this damage is a critical hit, this time you will get accurate and final damage × 2

hel:magic_clover.name: Magic Clover
hel:magic_clover.effect_text: When equipped for 1 turn, it can be triggered: Select the target, increase its critical strike multiplier by +1× this turn and gain 8 stacks of luck, and then destroy this equipment.
hel:magic_clover.description: The good luck generated by magic cannot be stopped.

hel:magic_dice.name: Magic Dice
hel:magic_dice.effect_text: Deal 6[[icon:D]]to the target; if this damage is a critical hit, all remaining luck will be consumed. Each layer consumed will cause 2[[icon:electric_damage]]to the target.
hel:magic_dice.description: Trade all the good luck for damage.

hel:blood_dice.name: Blood Dice
hel:blood_dice.effect_text: Give yourself 12 stacks of luck; cause 6[[icon:D]]to yourself. This damage will definitely be a critical hit and does not consume luck.

hel:bugatti.name: Bugatti
hel:bugatti.effect_text: When the equipment exists, the maximum number of cards in the target's hand is -1, and 2 more cards will be drawn each turn.
hel:bugatti.description: The Fast and the Furious, but why is it a bit crowded…

hel:magic_fire.name: Magic Fire
hel:magic_fire.effect_text: Apply 1 stack of Fire to the target
hel:magic_fire.description: The flames fueled by magic will continue to grow.

hel:gunpowder.name: Gunpowder
hel:gunpowder.effect_text: Deal 2[[icon:D]]×3 to the target; each time it hits, cause the target[[icon:F]]to be resolved immediately once, and then give it[[icon:F]]stacks -1

hel:magic_gunpowder.name: Magic Gunpowder
hel:magic_gunpowder.description: The gunpowder generated by magic turns damage into its own fuel.

hel:hel_lightning.name: Hel Lightning
hel:hel_lightning.effect_text: Apply (2 + number of target equipment) layers[[icon:F]]to the target
hel:hel_lightning.description: The gear you're proud of will weigh you down.

hel:magma.name: Magma
hel:magma.effect_text: Deal 6[[icon:D]]to the target; applies 1 stack of[[icon:F]]to the target on hit
hel:magma.description: You are sick, drink more boiled water!

hel:lava.name: Lava
hel:lava.effect_text: Apply 4 stacks of[[icon:F]]to all selectable targets

hel:deliverance.name: Deliverance
hel:deliverance.effect_text: Deal (target's current hand size ×2+2)[[icon:D]] to the target
hel:deliverance.description: In that light, I found deliverance.
